Main.dc.html.title: Town v1a · scene, then panels: the camera holds on the town hex, services are option cards, each opens its own panel. Town name, greeting, gold, prices and quests are placeholders

Town-v1b-Hub.dc.html.title: Town v1b · town hub: a menu screen with a button per service, the same panels

Town-v1c-MapPopup.dc.html.title: Town v1c · straight to services: walking onto the town opens a pop-up over the map listing its services, each opens its panel

Town-v2a-Counter.dc.html.title: Town v2a · shop as the shopkeeper's counter: the scene stays, the shopkeeper's line on top, items on a wooden counter along the bottom; tapping one opens the gear screen's item pop-up with Buy or Sell. Shopkeeper, lines and prices are placeholders

Town-v2b-TwoTrays.dc.html.title: Town v2b · shop as two trays: the shop's stock and the shared inventory side by side; drag an item across, or tap it and use the button between, to buy or sell. No tabs

Town-v2c-ShelfCards.dc.html.title: Town v2c · shop as shelf cards: each item is a big card (rarity band, icon, name, price) dealt in a row that scrolls sideways; tapping one turns it over to show its details and Buy

Town-v2d-InnkeeperMenu.dc.html.title: Town v2d · inn as the innkeeper's menu: the innkeeper's line on top, services as cards with their price on the band (Rest the night, and [Inn extra] for later inn services). Resting dims to night and back, then the results show in the line

Town-v2e-InnNight.dc.html.title: Town v2e · a night at the inn: the board becomes the inn's interior (bar, hearth, tables), the party gathers at a table, companions trade banter lines (placeholders), mugs go up, night falls and morning comes, then the results

Ref-Explore-v8b.dc.html.title: Linked · Exploration v8b (copied; Debug → Town v1a / v1b / v1c opens each variant, and Leave or Back comes back here)

Ref-Gear-v8d.dc.html.title: Linked · Character & gear v8d (copied; opened by the equipment button; Back to map returns to the exploration copy)

Town-v3a-Square.dc.html.title: Town v3a · the town square: walking in swaps the board for the town's own hexes (well, market stall, quest board post, the inn at the back, houses); each card matches a place. With the chosen shop (v2a counter) and inn (v2e night at the bar, ending in v1's rest results)

Town-v3b-TapBuildings.dc.html.title: Town v3b · v3a, and the stall, the quest board post and the inn glow and can be tapped; the party walks there first (from the cards too)

Town-v3c-Townsfolk.dc.html.title: Town v3c · v3b plus life: townsfolk wander the square (tap one for a [Townsfolk line] or [Rumour]) and smoke rises from the chimneys

Town-v4-Camera.dc.html.title: Town v4 · v3a (chosen) with the camera: drag to pan, pinch to zoom, twist to rotate, wheel and right-drag on PC, the nav button beside equipment. A quick tap moves the bar banter on. Entering or leaving the inn, or opening the shop counter, eases the camera back to frame it

Ref-Explore-v8b-ForV4.dc.html.title: Linked · Exploration v8b (copied; Debug → Town v4 opens v4, and Leave comes back here)

Ref-Gear-v8d-ForV4.dc.html.title: Linked · Character & gear v8d (copied; opened by the equipment button)

Town-v5a-NavFan.dc.html.title: Town v5a · the nav button's camera buttons fan out as a small honeycomb above it, over the open board, clear of the cards; a tap on the board closes them

Town-v5b-NavTray.dc.html.title: Town v5b · the camera buttons sit in a small wood tray that pops up above the nav button, on top of everything; a tap on the board closes it

Town-v5c-NavRoom.dc.html.title: Town v5c · the camera buttons open to the right as before, and while they're open the card row (town cards, the shop counter, the inn's cards) slides right to make room

Ref-Explore-v8b-ForV5.dc.html.title: Linked · Exploration v8b (copied; Debug → Town v5a / v5b / v5c opens each, and Leave comes back here)

Ref-Gear-v8d-ForV5.dc.html.title: Linked · Character & gear v8d (copied; opened by the equipment button)

Town-v6a-NavFan.dc.html.title: Town v6a · v5a's fan moved in to hug the nav button: up-right of it, two above, one to its right, over the cards

Town-v6b-NavTray.dc.html.title: Town v6b · v5b's tray moved down to sit right on the nav button, its tail pointing at it

Ref-Explore-v8b-ForV6.dc.html.title: Linked · Exploration v8b (copied; Debug → Town v6a / v6b opens each, and Leave comes back here)

Ref-Gear-v8d-ForV6.dc.html.title: Linked · Character & gear v8d (copied; opened by the equipment button)

Town-v6c-NavBetween.dc.html.title: Town v6c · the nav button sits between Quests and equipment, the three hexes touching in a zig-zag; opened, the camera buttons fan out against it on the right (v6a's fan)

Ref-Explore-v8b-ForV6c.dc.html.title: Linked · Exploration v8b (copied; Debug → Town v6a / v6b / v6c opens each, and Leave from v6c comes back here)

Ref-Gear-v8d-ForV6c.dc.html.title: Linked · Character & gear v8d (copied; opened by v6c's equipment button)

Town-v7-Tweaks.dc.html.title: Town v7 · v6c (standard) with the new-item and new-quest dots moved to the top left of their buttons, and the rest's results card centred on the screen

Ref-Explore-v8b-ForV7.dc.html.title: Linked · Exploration v8b (copied; Debug → Town v7 opens v7, and Leave comes back here)

Ref-Gear-v8d-ForV7.dc.html.title: Linked · Character & gear v8d (copied; opened by the equipment button)

v1.text: v1 · three ways into a town. Try the Shop (Buy and Sell), the Inn and the Quest board

refs.text: Linked screens · exploration (way in and out) and gear

v2.text: v2 · on v1a's scene: three shops (a–c) and two inns (d–e); the quest board stays as in v1

v3.text: v3 · the whole town on a town-square board: shop v2a, inn v2e with v1's results, quest board v1

v4.text: v4 · the town square with the camera, as in scenes

v5.text: v5 · keeping the opened camera buttons clear of the cards: fan, pop-up tray, or the cards make room

v6.text: v6 · the fan and the tray moved in close to the nav button

v7.text: v7 · v6c's layout as standard, with the notification dots and the rest card fixed
